core: Cranial sensory organ and nerve morphogenesis
qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial ganglia
name: Embryonic eye, inner ear and cranial ganglion morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern embryonic morphogenesis of head sensory organs and their nerves (eye, inner ear, cranial/trigeminal ganglia, taste papilla); eye structures separate it from the olfactory/facial confusables and cranial ganglia from the eye-and-ear confusable.

qualifier: replication-dependent histone stem-loop mRNAs and Pol II termination
name: Histone mRNA 3'-end processing and transcription termination
rationale: Members cover stem-loop cleavage, SLBP-dependent/independent histone pre-mRNA processing, histone mRNA decay and coupled Pol II termination, unlike confusables on capping, splicing and mRNA export.

qualifier: Rap1-driven inside-out activation and MAPK linkage
name: Rap1-driven integrin activation and adhesion signalling
rationale: Members share integrin activation and integrin-dependent cell adhesion, with Rap1 signalling and p130Cas/GRB2:SOS MAPK linkage distinguishing it from leukocyte-extravasation and shear-stress confusables.

name: RNA polymerase I initiation and rDNA chromatin regulation
rationale: Members cover Pol I preinitiation, promoter opening/escape and chromatin remodellers (NoRC, B-WICH, SIRT1, CSB) that switch rRNA genes on or off, unlike confusables on Pol I/III elongation-termination or MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis.

name: Mitochondrial DNA maintenance and mRNA turnover
rationale: Members concern mtDNA replication and repair plus mitochondrial mRNA stability and decay, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial transcription, tRNA processing and translation.

qualifier: NIK-dependent non-canonical arm and IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies
name: Non-canonical NF-kB signalling and IKK-deficiency immunodeficiencies
rationale: Members center on NIK-driven non-canonical NF-kB (TNFSF, Dectin-1) and IKK/IkBa defects causing EDA-ID and SCID, distinguishing them from TLR/NOD canonical IKK recruitment and TNFR1 regulation confusables.

name: Dendritic cell differentiation and antigen-presenting T cell costimulation
rationale: Members concern dendritic cell differentiation/activation signatures and APC-dependent T cell activation and costimulation, distinct from regulatory T cell, NK cell and generic surface-signature confusables.

name: Ferroptosis regulation and NADPH-dependent oxidative stress defence
rationale: Members share iron/lipid peroxidation death control, ROS detoxification and isocitrate-linked NADPH regeneration; ferroptosis distinguishes it from pentose-phosphate, vitamin C and NFE2L2-only confusables.

name: Cilium assembly, motility and centrosome–microtubule organization
rationale: Members span ciliogenesis, intraflagellar transport, axoneme/sperm flagellum and photoreceptor outer segment, centriole and microtubule organization, whereas confusables are mitotic spindle/cell-cycle or Hedgehog/planar-polarity programmes.

name: G protein–phospholipase C and protein kinase C signalling
rationale: Members share PLC-generated IP3/DAG second messengers driving calcium and PKC (G beta:gamma, Gq, LPA receptors, phorbol ester), unlike cAMP, BCR or Wnt-calcium confusables.

name: Chondroitin sulfate and glycosaminoglycan linkage-region biosynthesis disorders
rationale: Members are chondroitin sulfate chain and tetrasaccharide linkage-region synthesis and their Ehlers-Danlos/skeletal dysplasia defects, distinct from keratan, heparan/dermatan sulfate and dystroglycan confusables.

core: Macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
name: M-CSF-driven macrophage and microglial proliferation and activation
rationale: Members concern M-CSF signalling and macrophage proliferation together with microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity; M-CSF separates it from glial-regulation confusables and microglia from the CSF1/DAP12 confusable.

core: Basement membrane and skeletal muscle development
name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation, basement membrane and skeletal muscle development
rationale: Members cover DAG1 O-mannosyl glycosylation and dystroglycanopathies, laminin/basement membrane assembly and skeletal muscle/NMJ development, unlike collagen, GAG-glycosylation and sarcomere confusables.

qualifier: osteoclast activity with IGF and phosphate responses
name: Osteoclast-mediated bone remodelling, mineralization and IGF/phosphate responses
rationale: Members concern bone mineralization, osteoclast differentiation/fusion and resorption with IGF, phosphate and FGF23-Klotho responses, whereas confusables are osteoblast/Wnt or tooth mineralization programmes.

name: Glycoside-sensitive sodium–potassium pump ion homeostasis
rationale: Members share Na+/K+-ATPase-driven sodium export, potassium import and electrochemical gradient maintenance with cardiac glycoside response, unlike potassium-channel and renal sodium transport confusables.

qualifier: type II, type III and alpha responses
name: Interferon gamma, lambda and alpha responses
rationale: Members are IFN-gamma signalling and its regulation, type III interferon production/response and IFN-alpha response modules, distinct from IL-10/IL-20 family and other interleukin confusables.

name: Keratan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: All three members concern keratan sulfate synthesis (including CHST6 deficiency), distinguishing it from chondroitin/heparan/dermatan sulfate synthesis and mucopolysaccharidosis degradation confusables.

name: Urea cycle and citrulline–arginine synthesis with OTC deficiency
rationale: Members share urea cycle ornithine/citrulline/arginine/aspartate metabolism with OTC deficiency and enzyme regulation, distinguishing it from other urea-cycle-disorder, glutamate/proline and amino acid transport confusables.

name: Hepatobiliary bile acid, bilirubin and drug clearance
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis/transport/signalling, bilirubin glucuronidation and heme degradation, and SLCO/ABC-mediated xenobiotic ADME, unlike intestinal lipid absorption and organic cation transport confusables.

qualifier: S-palmitoylation cycling and RAS C-terminal processing
name: Protein S-palmitoylation cycling and RAS C-terminal processing
rationale: Members concern cysteine palmitoylation/depalmitoylation, N-terminal lipidation and RAS C-terminal processing, distinct from RAB geranylgeranylation, Hedgehog and Wnt lipidation confusables.

name: NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated interleukin-1 processing
rationale: Members share NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome activation (including P2X7 purinergic triggering) and IL-1 precursor processing, unlike CASP4/5, AIM2/IPAF pyroptosis and IL-18/IL-17 confusables.

name: Canonical Wnt and Notch signalling with intramembrane proteolysis
rationale: Members span beta-catenin destruction-complex regulation and its cancer mutants plus Notch receptor processing and nuclear signalling, ERBB4 and p75NTR cleavage; Notch/intramembrane proteolysis distinguishes it from Wnt-only and Hedgehog confusables.

name: Two-pore-domain and ATP-sensitive potassium channels in resting potential
rationale: Members are K2P, KATP and calcium-activated potassium channels governing resting potential and hyperpolarization, distinguished from Na+/K+ pump and action-potential confusables by the channel families.

qualifier: ATP-sensitive potassium channels in ischemic response
name: Purinergic signalling and ATP-sensitive potassium channels in ischemia
rationale: Members share extracellular ATP/adenosine signalling (P2Y, P1, NTPDases, ATP export) with KATP channels and ischemia/hypoxia responses, which the calcium, histamine/prostanoid and PLC confusables lack.

name: Ubiquitin-dependent endocytic downregulation of ERBB receptor signalling
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin-dependent endocytosis and MVB/lysosomal sorting that terminates EGFR/ERBB signalling, distinguishing it from generic ESCRT and MET/PTK6 signalling confusables.
